description_text:
ComputerCare has spent more than 20 years building something rare in the IT world: a company where technical excellence and genuine human connection are valued equally. We're the trusted partner that IT leaders turn to when technology can't afford to fail. As a woman-owned business serving innovative companies worldwide, we combine certified technical expertise with a human approach. Whether it's managing complex device lifecycles for global teams or performing authorized repairs for Apple, Lenovo, HP and Dell devices, our work directly impacts how thousands of people stay productive every day. We never outsource our work because we believe in accountability, quality, and building lasting relationships—with our clients and as a team. 
If you're passionate about technology, take pride in solving real problems, and want to be part of a company that values both technical excellence and the people behind it, ComputerCare is where you belong.
Come join us in our mission of being the Human Side of Hardware! 
We're building our data capabilities and looking for a hands-on Lead Analytics Engineer to take ownership of our data function. As our first dedicated analytics hire, you'll own the pipelines, models, metric definitions, reporting, and data quality that our operations teams and leaders rely on to run the business.
In this role, you'll work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to turn operational questions into trusted data products, establish consistent definitions for the metrics that matter, and automate reporting that is currently assembled manually.
This is a hands-on builder role, not a people-management role. You'll write SQL, build and operate pipelines, and create models yourself. At the same time, you'll have the autonomy to determine priorities, establish analytics standards, and challenge or clarify requests when the underlying business question or data definition is unclear.
This role is ideal for an experienced analytics professional who is energized by ownership, ambiguity, and the opportunity to build a trusted analytics capability from the ground up.
What You'll Do: 

Own the Data Architecture: Own, maintain, optimize, and scale our Snowflake data warehouse, transformation layer, and ETL/ELT pipelines, making pragmatic architecture decisions as the business grows.

Build and Operate Integrations: Stand up and own reliable ingestion from systems such as NetSuite, Jira/service platforms, and custom applications. Monitor pipelines, troubleshoot failures, and ensure data arrives accurately and reliably.

Drive Business Intelligence: Own our BI layer (currently utilizing HEX), with the opportunity to evaluate and migrate to tools like Tableau or Looker as we scale.

Partner with Leadership: Work hand-in-hand with the COO to translate operational goals into data models, dashboards, and actionable insights.

Own Data Quality & Governance: Establish trusted metric definitions, documentation, testing, and data-quality standards. Maintain the metric dictionary and clearly communicate when data is incomplete or should not be relied upon.

Automate Operational Reporting: Take ownership of recurring operational reporting, ad hoc analysis, SLA reporting, and client review data. Build repeatable, automated solutions that replace manual reporting processes.

Experiment & Innovate: Stay creative. We want someone who suggests new tools, tests experimental models, and constantly looks for better ways to solve problems.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the primary data consultant for operations, finance, and engineering leaders. Translate their real-world operational challenges into data models and actionable, automated dashboards.

Roles & Responsibilities

The "Hybrid" Professional: You sit comfortably at the intersection of Data Engineering (building pipelines, data modeling) and Data Analytics (BI, dashboards, telling stories with data).

Meticulous & Detail-Oriented: You care deeply about clean code, accurate numbers, and reliable pipelines. You build appropriate tests and controls so leaders can trust the numbers they use to make decisions.

An Entrepreneurial Builder: You are excited by a blank canvas. You want to get your hands dirty, build from scratch, and take extreme ownership of your work.

Curious & Adaptive: You love to learn, experiment with new technologies, and pivot quickly when a better solution presents itself.

A High-Impact Communicator: You don't just love data; you love talking to the people who use it. You can sit down with a warehouse manager or a software engineer, understand their pain points, and build a data solution that makes their job easier.

What You'll Bring: 

Experience: 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, data engineering, or analytics, including meaningful experience building data models and pipelines that others depend on. Experience as the first or only data practitioner is strongly preferred.

Cloud Data Warehousing: Strong, hands-on experience with Snowflake (architecture, performance tuning, and optimization).

SQL & Pipeline Mastery: Advanced SQL skills are a must. Experience with integration/ETL tools (Celigo, Fivetran, dbt, or custom API scripting) is highly valued.

BI & Visualization: Experience building impactful dashboards. Familiarity with HEX is a major plus; experience with Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker is required.

Ecosystem Familiarity: Experience working with data originating from ERPs (NetSuite), project management tools (Jira), and custom web applications.

Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to operate with limited structure, identify the highest-value analytics work, set priorities, and move from problem definition through delivery without waiting for a backlog of assigned requests.

title: AWS Data Engineer (Senior) (Freelancer)
description_text:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
This is a senior freelance role in our Data Platform Modernization pillar: consolidating and migrating customer data infrastructure on AWS in weeks, not quarters. Customers come to us after a data program has stalled — pipelines nobody trusts, warehouses nobody runs new workloads on, a modernization that produced diagrams instead of production systems.
Aedeon handles automated source discovery, schema mapping, lineage extraction, and parallel-run validation. You take the work that needs a senior engineer's judgment: pipeline builds on EMR and Glue, data models for Redshift, Snowflake, Athena, and Presto, Airflow orchestration, and the troubleshooting that gets a system stable enough to cut over. Freelance here means real delivery work on real engagements — not staff augmentation into someone else's backlog.
What you will do?

Build and maintain data pipelines on Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue that run in production.

Design data models and end-user querying on Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto.

Build and maintain pipeline orchestration with Airflow.

Work with other teams to understand data needs and design the solutions that meet them.

Troubleshoot and optimize pipelines and data models until they hold up under real load.

Document and communicate technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.

Track new AWS data technologies and judge their impact on the systems we run.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

3+ years of experience working with PySpark and SQL.

2+ years of experience building and maintaining data pipelines using Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue.

2+ years of experience with data modeling and end-user querying using Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto.

Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to work independently and within a team environment.

AWS Data Analytics Specialty Certification

Experience with Agile development methodology

How we work?

We run a forward-deployed model: engineers embed with delivery teams, own their piece of the outcome, and ship against committed dates. This is a remote freelance engagement, so we'll be straight about the shape: you work project-by-project inside that model, with Aedeon absorbing the repetitive layer so your billed time goes to engineering judgment, not manual validation. You'll work independently, coordinate closely with the engagement team, and your output lands in production systems that customers sign off on.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description_text:
The role
As a Senior Data Engineer at Solflare, you’ll build and optimize the data systems that power our product insights and decision-making. You’ll work closely with analysts, product managers, and engineers to design scalable pipelines, improve our data infrastructure, and make reliable data accessible across teams.
Our Data team was formed last year and currently has six people working across data analysis and engineering. The foundations are in place, but the team is still new enough for you to have a real impact on how we model data, design our systems, and work as a team.
The scale and variety of our data make this role especially interesting. Since blockchain data is public, we can analyze user behavior at the individual transaction level across the wider Solana ecosystem, not only within Solflare. This gives us a much clearer view of the full user journey, including how people use other wallets and protocols and where new trends are starting to emerge.
One of our biggest challenges is connecting on-chain and off-chain data into a coherent user model. A blockchain public key, an app device ID, and an internal user ID all need to be mapped reliably so we can understand the full journey. At the same time, on-chain data volumes are growing quickly, making pipeline performance and query-cost optimization increasingly important.
Our stack includes BigQuery, dbt Cloud, Python, GCP, PostHog, Dune, Metabase, and Tableau. Claude Code is deeply integrated into our day-to-day work, so AI-assisted development is already the norm here, not an experiment.
We’re looking for an engineer who can not only build robust data systems, but also help shape the technical direction of a growing Data team.
Core responsibilities:

Data collection & preparation: You’ll gather data from a variety of sources, including databases, APIs, event tracking tools like PostHog and spreadsheets - ensuring it’s accurate, complete, and relevant to the business questions at hand.

Design and build scalable data pipelines: Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT processes that collect, transform, and load data from multiple sources into our data warehouse.

Data infrastructure: Manage and improve our data infrastructure using modern tools and cloud services (GCP), ensuring high availability and low latency.

Automation & reliability: Automate data workflows, monitoring, and quality checks to ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reliability across all systems.

Collaboration: Work with analytics and engineering teams to ensure data needs are met; from ingestion to analysis.

Data integrity: Ensure that data is secure, well-documented, and accessible to those who need it most.

Requirements:

Experience: 7+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role dealing with large-scale data systems.

Programming: Proficiency in Python, especially for building data processing pipelines.

Data pipelines: Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools (preferably dbt) and data orchestration.

Data warehousing: Experience with modern data warehouse technologies such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar.

Databases & SQL: Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational and NoSQL databases.

Cloud platforms: Practical experience with cloud services (preferably GCP) for data storage, compute, and orchestration.

Version control & CI/CD: Familiarity with Git and data CI/CD workflows for versioned, testable data deployments.

AI-assisted development: Experience integrating AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) into your engineering workflow for faster iteration and higher-quality output. 

Spreadsheets: Solid experience using Excel or Google Sheets for quick analysis and pivot tables.

Nice to have:

Fintech/banking/insurance/web3 industry experience

Experience with processing on-chain data (e.g. using data from Dune, Solscan, etc.).

Personality Traits We Value

Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.

Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride – no excuses, no shortcuts.

Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.

Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.

Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.

Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.

Flexibility: Remote or office – up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time – work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement.

Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few.

Learn about Crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.
Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.
About us
Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 4 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 140 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets – achieving true financial independence.
Our culture
At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive – starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth – yours, ours, and society’s – you’ll feel right at home.

This role is based remotely in the East US, the UK, Ireland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Estonia and Israel. 
Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. 
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. 
The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Product Operations Analyst to strengthen how R&D decisions are made at DoiT and to help drive our AI transformation across the organization. 
This role is built for someone who cares deeply about business results, not just the data itself. You care about the customers we serve and use AI tools, data, and voice of the customer systems as tools to improve how we discover, define, build, mature, and iterate our products.
You’ll operate at the intersection of product, data, AI, and customer insight helping build and maintain the measurement and analytics foundations that ensure our product investments are grounded in reliable signals and real customer needs. 
Reporting to the Head of Product Operations and part of the Product and R&D organization, this is a high-impact individual contributor role suited for someone with strong data, analytics, and AI experience who enjoys building scalable processes and working cross-functionally.
As DoiT’s product portfolio grows, clear measurement and structured customer insight become increasingly important. This role helps ensure that product decisions are informed, measurable, and aligned with business outcomes, enabling the team to build with greater confidence and focus.
Responsibilities
1) Product Measurement & Instrumentation
Support and evolve the framework and systems that turn product behavior into trusted, actionable signals:

Partner with Engineering to define and maintain event taxonomy, tracking standards, and instrumentation quality

Build and maintain scalable, self-service dashboards for product teams

Help establish and document clear metric definitions as a shared source of truth.

Contribute to improving how and what we measure as the product evolves.

Leverage AI to repeatedly unlock insights and recommendations from these signals

Outcome: Product teams have reliable data to evaluate performance and make informed decisions.
2) Analytics & Data Foundations
Strengthen the product analytics ecosystem and data models that power decision-making.

Work within our product analytics stack (e.g., Mixpanel, Segment, Looker) to ensure accurate and accessible reporting.

Build and maintain dbt models for core product entities and behaviors.

Contribute to a clean, usable metric layer for business stakeholders.

Help structure and analyze Voice of the Customer inputs (e.g., support, churn, NPS, sales feedback, customer interviews)

Support data quality through testing, monitoring, documentation, and automation

Deploy the best AI tooling available to make our data a differentiator

Outcome: Product data is systematically consistent, accessible, and trusted.
3) Insight Generation & Reporting
Translate product usage and customer signals into clear, actionable insights.

Deliver recurring product analytics reporting (adoption, engagement, retention)

Contribute to analytics readouts to business stakeholders and executives with clear findings and recommendations

Perform analyses that connect product behavior to revenue and retention outcomes

Support automated reporting and AI-assisted workflows while maintaining metric integrity

Strive to make insights and reporting automated and self-service, heavily assisted through best practices with emerging AI techniques

Outcome: Product and business stakeholders regularly use analytics and customer insights to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Qualifications

5+ years of experience in product analytics or related roles. Experience working closely with digital product teams and influencing decisions through data. 
AI-First mentality. Must have a practical understanding of how AI is reshaping analytics workflows. The ideal candidate will have experience using AI to accelerate insight generation, documentation, and distribution while understanding how to build guardrails, trust, and safe operationalization of AI. 

Systems thinker & operator's mindset. Track record of building systems that scale across many groups.

A “Builder” mindset. We have bold ambition, and we move fast. Whether we’re missing processes, systems, tools, data, or buy-in, your instinct must be to create, solve, and build paths that may not exist today.

Comfort operating in ambiguity. Ability to prioritize, structure problems, and execute independently while collaborating across teams.

Clear communicator. Experience presenting analysis to product managers and business stakeholders, translating complex findings into actionable recommendations.Strong analytical foundation. Advanced SQL required. Experience with event-based analytics and familiarity with tools such as Mixpanel (or similar), Looker (or similar BI tools), Segment (or similar), and dbt. Domain familiarity (preferred). Exposure to public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), FinOps/cloud cost management, and enterprise SaaS company concepts is preferred.
How success will be measured

Product teams rely on analytics to evaluate feature performance and guide roadmap decisions

Core product metrics are clearly defined, trusted, and consistently used

Product insights contribute to improvements in adoption, engagement, and retention

Voice of the Customer signals are organized and incorporated into feedback loops

Data is readily accessible, well-documented, and clear, enabling efficient decision-making

Analytics and insights are available quickly and require less manual effort

AI is being used across our product operating model to incorporate signals into every decision across Product, Design, and Engineering

AI-driven insights are systematically integrated to inform and optimize critical decision-making throughout every phase of our product lifecycle, from initial concept to post-launch iteration.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. 
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. 
The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Product Operations Analyst to strengthen how R&D decisions are made at DoiT and to help drive our AI transformation across the organization. 
This role is built for someone who cares deeply about business results, not just the data itself. You care about the customers we serve and use AI tools, data, and voice of the customer systems as tools to improve how we discover, define, build, mature, and iterate our products.
You’ll operate at the intersection of product, data, AI, and customer insight helping build and maintain the measurement and analytics foundations that ensure our product investments are grounded in reliable signals and real customer needs. 
Reporting to the Head of Product Operations and part of the Product and R&D organization, this is a high-impact individual contributor role suited for someone with strong data, analytics, and AI experience who enjoys building scalable processes and working cross-functionally.

Build and maintain scalable, self-service dashboards for product teams

Contribute to improving how and what we measure as the product evolves.

Leverage AI to repeatedly unlock insights and recommendations from these signals

Work within our product analytics stack (e.g., Mixpanel, Segment, Looker) to ensure accurate and accessible reporting.

Contribute to a clean, usable metric layer for business stakeholders.

Support data quality through testing, monitoring, documentation, and automation

Deploy the best AI tooling available to make our data a differentiator

Outcome: Product data is systematically consistent, accessible, and trusted.
3) Insight Generation & Reporting
Translate product usage and customer signals into clear, actionable insights.

Deliver recurring product analytics reporting (adoption, engagement, retention)

Contribute to analytics readouts to business stakeholders and executives with clear findings and recommendations

Perform analyses that connect product behavior to revenue and retention outcomes

Support automated reporting and AI-assisted workflows while maintaining metric integrity

Strive to make insights and reporting automated and self-service, heavily assisted through best practices with emerging AI techniques

Outcome: Product and business stakeholders regularly use analytics and customer insights to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Qualifications

5+ years of experience in product analytics or related roles. Experience working closely with digital product teams and influencing decisions through data. 
AI-First mentality. Must have a practical understanding of how AI is reshaping analytics workflows. The ideal candidate will have experience using AI to accelerate insight generation, documentation, and distribution while understanding how to build guardrails, trust, and safe operationalization of AI. 

Systems thinker & operator's mindset. Track record of building systems that scale across many groups.

A “Builder” mindset. We have bold ambition, and we move fast. Whether we’re missing processes, systems, tools, data, or buy-in, your instinct must be to create, solve, and build paths that may not exist today.

Comfort operating in ambiguity. Ability to prioritize, structure problems, and execute independently while collaborating across teams.

Clear communicator. Experience presenting analysis to product managers and business stakeholders, translating complex findings into actionable recommendations.Strong analytical foundation. Advanced SQL required. Experience with event-based analytics and familiarity with tools such as Mixpanel (or similar), Looker (or similar BI tools), Segment (or similar), and dbt. Domain familiarity (preferred). Exposure to public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), FinOps/cloud cost management, and enterprise SaaS company concepts is preferred.
How success will be measured

Product teams rely on analytics to evaluate feature performance and guide roadmap decisions

Core product metrics are clearly defined, trusted, and consistently used

Product insights contribute to improvements in adoption, engagement, and retention

Voice of the Customer signals are organized and incorporated into feedback loops

Data is readily accessible, well-documented, and clear, enabling efficient decision-making

Analytics and insights are available quickly and require less manual effort

AI is being used across our product operating model to incorporate signals into every decision across Product, Design, and Engineering

AI-driven insights are systematically integrated to inform and optimize critical decision-making throughout every phase of our product lifecycle, from initial concept to post-launch iteration.

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. 
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

title: [REMOTE] Product Analyst
description_text:
CrazyGames.com, one of the world’s largest casual gaming platforms with over 60M monthly visitors, is looking for a (full or hybrid) remote experienced Product Analyst in Europe.
Your mission will be to support the product team in identifying problems & opportunities for our 3 million daily users, leveraging the data we collect. You will report to the Chief Product Officer and will work closely with product, data & engineering teams.
On a typical day you might:

Work with Product managers to identify and quantify the most important opportunities in our First-Time-User Experience

Figure out when users are quitting a game never to come back.

Understand how the latest product release are impacting our stats.

Work with engineers to identify in what scenarios user progress is not being saved.

Combine AB tests data analysis with testing as a user to understand reduced average playtime on certain screen solutions.

Key outcomes for the role:

Within 1 month, you have a good understanding of the current product and the data stack, and found 3 quick wins that improve CrazyGames by combining data analysis with user testing

Within 3 months, you took responsibility for following up on the effect of our product releases, interpreting positive or negative consequences of changes that our engineering team made as well as communicating those consequences.

Within 6 months, you’re meaningfully supporting product managers in quantifying improvement opportunities across our player journeys and choosing the right priorities.

Within 12 months, you have improved key product KPIs(conversion to gameplay, lifetime playtime or CURR)by at least 3%. 

What we offer:

Join the product & data team alongside product managers, designer, analyst and data scientist

Work with our elite engineering team of 15+ experienced engineers

A modern tech stack on a massive scale (over 300,000,000 gameplays per month across device types from users across the globe)

A lot of responsibility and freedom. We hire only experts and trust them to deliver excellent results.

Flexible working hours and location. The results are what counts!

1-2 team weeks per year. We pay for flights and accommodation so you can have fun with the team.

The opportunity to play games and claim it's work.

Requirements
Reach out if:

You have a strong interest in data-driven digital products and user experience.

You can spot patterns in data. You can not leave a question unanswered, or come with a half-baked answer.

You know how to gather, process and interpret various data sources to support product decisions (analytics, feedback, trends, user tests, ...), and you know SQL very well.

You’re used to leveraging AI for efficient analysis, without giving in on critical thinking 

You are intelligent, efficient, and organized. You have an attention to detail.

You like open, efficient, and to-the-point communication and you have experience in working remotely.

You have relevant experience working in a company which has large digital platforms catering to an extensive user base. Experience in the Gaming, Media or Entertainment sector is a plus.

Please note: glaring use of GenAI technologies to fill in the screening questions will result in disqualification. 
Highlights
Shape the future of casual gaming. Join us in building the platform enjoyed by 3M+ players every day. Help us make strategic product decisions in a data driven way.

title: AI Service Analyst
description_text:
AI Service Analyst
ICS.AI · Remote (UK), occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites 
· Full-time, permanent · £26,500 – £30,000 · Entry level / graduate
Build the AI agents that run our service desk — not reset passwords.
ICS.AI is a UK AI consultancy delivering AI transformation to the public sector — local government, higher education and the wider public estate. Our clients commit to transformation on the strength of savings guarantees, and we are held to contractual service levels once our solutions are live. That makes our service data a commercial asset, not admin overhead.
We are hiring an AI Service Analyst to own the day-to-day operation of our service management function, and to build it properly from the ground up. You will be the single point of coordination between clients raising issues, the delivery and engineering teams who resolve them, and the Customer Success team who own the relationship.
This is a first or second role. You do not need to be able to fix the technology. You need to be able to work out what is actually happening, get it to the right person, and tell the client the truth about it clearly and on time.
What you’ll be doing

Running our Zendesk platform end to end — reviewing every incoming ticket, categorising and prioritising it against a consistent ITIL-aligned model, assigning it to the right resolver and chasing it to closure.

Early triage on live AI solutions: checking Azure service health, interrogating voice and language platforms, and reproducing what a client is reporting before it consumes a specialist’s time.

Problem management and root cause analysis — spotting patterns across incidents, assigning causes, and authoring RCA documents that go to clients.

Client communication and service reporting: proactive updates, SLA tracking, the weekly report pack, and service content for monthly and quarterly reviews.

Monthly trend analysis across the client portfolio, and the structured feedback loop from live service into our product roadmap.

Designing, building, shadow-running and tuning AI agents inside Zendesk for triage, classification and first response — including the guardrails that decide what an agent is never allowed to handle alone.

What makes this different from a service desk role
You will not be resetting passwords. Our tickets concern live AI solutions serving citizens and council staff — conversational assistants, voice services, agents and data platforms. And a genuine part of the job is building AI agents to handle the queue: that is what lets the function absorb a growing client base without growing headcount, and it is the difference between this post and a conventional service desk appointment. It is no-code work, but it needs someone who will iterate patiently rather than accept the first output.
What we’re looking for
We are not screening on a degree classification or a specific subject. What we care about is evidence of the following:

Excellent written English — clear, accurate and appropriate for a professional client audience.

Strong organisational discipline, and the ability to hold many open items without losing any of them.

An analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and spotting patterns.

Confidence and composure in direct contact with clients by email, phone and video, including when they are unhappy.

Competence with Microsoft 365, particularly Excel.

A genuine interest in AI and in how technology is used in public services.

Eligibility to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

ITIL 4 Foundation — not required at appointment; we will fund it within your first three months.

Any exposure to a ticketing platform (Zendesk, ServiceNow, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management), including a placement year.

Experience of local government, higher education or the wider public sector.

Familiarity with generative AI tools, or any experience of configuring or prompting them.

Exposure to chatbot, virtual agent or workflow automation configuration.

Basic understanding of cloud concepts, particularly Microsoft Azure, or any exposure to Power BI or similar.

What you don’t need

Coding or software engineering ability.

Machine learning or data science knowledge — agent building here is configuration and prompting.

Infrastructure, networking or telephony engineering skills.

Previous line management or commercial experience.

The package

£26,500 – £30,000, with progression to the top of the band on completion of ITIL 4 Foundation and your six-month review.

Full-time, permanent. Remote within the UK, with occasional travel to Basingstoke and to client sites.

A structured twelve-month development framework with reviews at three, six, nine and twelve months, and a described route to Senior AI Service Analyst.

Funded ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

£100 per month WFH Allowance

Vitality Healthcare Plan

Pension Scheme

25 days holiday

Demonstrated experience analysing customer success metrics, product usage, and engagement trends to inform sales decisions

Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards, with strong SQL skills and confidence working in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse

Proficiency in modern BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker), including building calculations, visualizations, and data models for both scheduled and ad hoc analysis

A sharp analytical mindset, comfortable framing a business question as a hypothesis and validating it with data

Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills, able to build trust and influence across sales, customer success, and analytics teams

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong quality and process orientation

Working knowledge of data governance principles, policies, and standards

A collaborative, energetic team player who can build influence across departments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working within Salesforce.com (SFDC)

Exposure to a modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, or similar tools)

Bachelor's degree

We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

description_text:
Healthesystems offers workplace flexibility with our Work-From-Home model, and a competitive compensation and benefits package including healthcare coverage, PTO, paid holidays, 401(k), company-provided life insurance/disability coverage, wellness options, and more.

Healthesystems welcomes candidates from these states:

Summary: The Business Systems Analyst collaborates with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, and other Agile Team members to translate software requirements into clear, actionable user stories and deliverables for the delivery team. The Business Systems Analyst serves as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, supporting effective execution across the Development Life Cycle. This role operates within a SAFe Agile environment and is accountable for ensuring requirements are clearly understood, well-defined, and ready to support successful delivery.
Key Responsibilities: “To simplify complexities for each customer.”
The Business Systems Analyst demonstrates reliable proficiency and autonomy, applying skills effectively in most scenarios while requiring minimal supervision and guidance.
Requirements Elicitation, Documentation & Process Mapping

Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to gather, identify, and define detailed business and technical requirements. Create clear, concise, and well-structured documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, and user stories that describe system features and functionality from the end-user perspective. Analyze and document current and future-state business processes and workflows to support a shared understanding of requirements and solution scope. Ensure requirements and process documentation align with business goals, objectives, and agreed-upon solution scope.
Requirements Research & Analysis

Conduct research and analysis to determine what the system must do to fulfill requirements across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), spanning all requirement types, including business, functional, non-functional, and transitional requirements. Clarify and refine requirements with stakeholders to resolve ambiguities, manage expectations, and maintain clear communication across teams. Analysis may include modeling, journey mapping, story mapping, and, when appropriate, limited code or API review using tools such as Swagger.
Adherence to BSA Standards & Contribution to Knowledge Sharing

Adhere to established BSA standards, processes, and documentation guidelines. Actively participate in BSA Communities of Practice and assist in the identification, documentation, communication, and maintenance of business analysis practices to ensure alignment with Agile methodology, organizational objectives, and BSA community goals. Create and maintain informational documentation to support knowledge sharing within the BSA team and Agile Teams.
Adherence to Agile and SAFe Practices

Operate within a SAFe Agile environment by following established Agile principles, practices, and ceremonies. Apply Agile documentation principles and support consistent, high-quality execution across iterations.
Backlog Management & Agile Execution Support

Refining and maintaining the product backlog using agreed-upon tools such as Jira. Responsibilities include identifying and documenting user stories, defining and refining shell stories, splitting stories appropriately, analyzing and documenting stories using modeling techniques, performing story mapping, and ensuring stories are properly tied to epics. Actively participate in backlog refinement sessions and Agile ceremonies, confirming stories meet the Definition of Ready, align with team goals and delivery timelines, and support maintaining at least two iterations of ready work in accordance with SAFe standards.
Facilitation & Collaboration

Facilitate and actively participate in meetings to ensure prioritized objectives are clearly defined and supported for timely execution. Lead or co-facilitate refinement sessions and contribute meaningfully to Agile ceremonies. Serve as a bridge between business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders by helping manage differing viewpoints constructively, promoting collaboration, alignment with goals, and a positive working environment. When needed, provide short-term support by backfilling Agile roles such as Product Owner or Scrum Master, with appropriate guidance.
Testing, Validation & Implementation Support

Provide ongoing support to delivery teams during testing and implementation. Responsibilities include answering user-story-related questions, collaborating with Product Owners and stakeholders to clarify requirements, reviewing technical designs for alignment with requirements and underlying needs, coordinating user acceptance testing, developing test plans, validating system changes, assisting with script writing, and supporting day-to-day production issues as needed.
Communication & Stakeholder Management

Identify and engage with key business and technical stakeholders to ensure their needs, concerns, and feedback are understood and incorporated into system and process requirements. Collaborate across teams and departments to support successful solution delivery. Serves as the bridge between business users, IT teams, and other stakeholders, all of whom might have differing viewpoints, requirements, or expectations.

Actively pursue opportunities to develop business analysis, technical, and domain knowledge. Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving methodologies. Contribute ideas and creative solutions to improve processes, systems, or services, supporting a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability. Thinks outside the box, solve problems in unique ways, and drives improvements that will make a difference in our organization.

title: Data Analyst
description_text:
About Us
YipitData is a market research and analytics firm that helps investment funds and Fortune 500 companies understand company performance, market trends, and competitive dynamics. Our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to produce insights that inform important business and investment decisions.
We operate globally, with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our people-centered culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—is built around transparency, ownership, and continuous learning.
What It's Like to Work Here

Ownership is real, not aspirational. Analysts own data products from methodology development through delivery and directly influence products used by leading investment firms.

Growth is driven by impact, not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. 

AI is a core working tool. We're actively rebuilding how analytical work gets done—using AI agents, automation, and new tooling to fundamentally change what's possible. 

About the Role
You’ll join one of our sector teams, covering industries such as consumer goods, software, or financial services. These teams build and maintain the analytical data products our clients rely on to understand companies and markets.
As an analyst on the team, you’ll develop deep expertise in a portfolio of proprietary datasets and methodologies. You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of your products, improving the way they are built, and identifying insights and opportunities that create value for clients.
You’ll initially work closely with a Data Lead to learn our datasets, methodologies, and quality standards. As your expertise grows, you’ll take on greater ownership, tackle more complex products, and help shape how your team works.
This role is well suited to someone who enjoys solving difficult analytical problems, cares deeply about accuracy, and wants to build data products that people depend on—not simply deliver one-off analyses.
We’re open to hiring this role at multiple levels. While the position is posted as Senior Data Analyst, we encourage applications from candidates with a range of experience who can demonstrate strong analytical judgment, ownership, and growth potential. Final title, scope, and compensation will be calibrated based on experience and demonstrated skills.
What You’ll Do:

Own data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You'll ramp into full ownership of your products and workflows with increasing autonomy as you build expertise.

Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients' key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You'll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights.

Tackle complex data problems using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require creative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous.

Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — increasing speed, reducing manual work, and automating portions of workflows. You'll build repeatable processes, maintain a high bar for correctness and quality, and validate AI-generated outputs.

Partner with Research, Engineering, Product, and other teams to solve problems, improve workflows, and deliver high-quality products.

Identify opportunities to improve products and processes — whether that's refining a methodology, exploring a new dataset, or finding a better way to do something. Contribute ideas that improve how your team operates and how we deliver value to clients.

Over your first year, you might:

Develop a new methodology that significantly improves the accuracy of an existing investment product.

Build an entirely new research product covering an adjacent market or investment theme.

Evaluate a new alternative dataset and determine how it can strengthen existing estimates or unlock new analytical capabilities.

Create an AI-powered analytical workflow that dramatically reduces the time required to develop recurring research.

Design a new dashboard or AI experience that changes how clients explore sector data.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

description_text:
About Us
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy. Our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights. The world's top investment funds and Fortune 500 companies depend on our data to drive high-stakes decisions.
We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It's Like to Work Here

Ownership is real, not aspirational. An analyst here can own a data product end-to-end—from methodology to client delivery—and directly influence products used by many of the world's largest investment firms.

Growth is driven by impact, not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. We promote based on what you've done, not how long you've been here.

AI is a core working tool. We're actively rebuilding how analytical work gets done—using AI agents, automation, and new tooling to fundamentally change what's possible. If you're excited by that, you'll thrive here.

About the Role
YipitData's Data Feeds team transforms our proprietary datasets into commercial data products used by many of the world's largest hedge funds, asset managers, and quantitative investors. Our products help investors answer questions about consumer spending, enterprise software adoption, cloud infrastructure, healthcare, and dozens of other markets—using proprietary datasets that clients integrate directly into their investment workflows.
The Data Feeds team creates products that fit seamlessly into client investment workflows—whether that's through granular datasets, aggregated metrics, forecasting methodologies, APIs, or entirely new AI-powered product experiences.
As an analyst on the team, you'll sit at the intersection of analytics, product, and commercialization. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Central Data, Data Science, Engineering, Quant Research, and Client Strategy to continuously improve how clients consume and derive value from our data.
We're hiring across multiple products, including:

Kepler — consumer transaction datasets powering institutional investment workflows through granular transaction data, aggregated metrics, and forecasting products.

Summit — B2B spend datasets built from purchase and invoice data, helping investors understand enterprise software, industrials, healthcare, and other sectors.

Edison – email receipt datasets built from one of the industry's largest anonymized inbox panels, helping investors track consumer purchases, subscriptions, travel, and digital commerce across thousands of merchants.

SpendHound – Proprietary B2B software spend datasets built from ERP, expense, and invoice data, helping investors understand software adoption, customer retention, competitive dynamics, and enterprise technology spending.

Cloud – Enterprise cloud infrastructure data covering AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud, combining proprietary spend panels with pricing and capacity data to help investors understand cloud growth, AI infrastructure demand, and competitive dynamics.

This role is different from a traditional Data Analyst position. Success isn't measured by how many analyses you complete. It's measured by the quality of the products you build, the customer problems you solve, and the leverage you create for clients and the business.
We’re open to hiring this role at multiple levels. While the position is posted as Senior Data Analyst, we encourage applications from candidates with a range of experience who can demonstrate strong analytical judgment, ownership, and growth potential. Final title, scope, and compensation will be calibrated based on experience and demonstrated skills.
As an analyst on the Data Feeds team, you will:

Own commercial data products – Own products end-to-end, from methodology development and product QA to feature design and ongoing product evolution. Develop deep expertise in how your product works and the investment workflows it supports.

Improve product quality through systems – Investigate complex data quality issues spanning upstream datasets, product methodologies, and downstream customer outputs. Build scalable monitoring, validation, and QA frameworks that improve quality while reducing manual effort.

Shape the evolution of the product – Work with Product Managers, Data Science, and Central Data. Identify opportunities for new methodologies, additional datasets, forecasting capabilities, AI-powered features, and entirely new product offerings.

Evaluate new data and methodologies – Analyze new internal and third-party datasets to determine whether they improve product accuracy, coverage, or customer value. Design experiments, quantify tradeoffs, and help determine what belongs in production.

Turn customer feedback into better products - Partner with Product Managers, Client Strategy and directly with sophisticated investors to understand how products are being used. Translate customer questions, trial feedback, and support escalations into durable product improvements.

Use AI to redesign analytical workflows – Leverage AI agents, automation, and evaluation frameworks to improve QA, documentation, methodology development, and customer-facing analytical experiences.

Build the next generation of data products – Look beyond maintaining today's products. Identify opportunities to create new analytical capabilities, improve client workflows, and expand the ways customers interact with our data.

Example Projects
Over your first year, you might:

Design a new aggregation methodology that significantly improves the accuracy of a commercial transaction product.

Evaluate a new third-party dataset and determine whether it should become part of a production product.

Build automated QA monitors that proactively detect regressions before customers notice them.

Partner with Data Science to evaluate the impact of model improvements on customer-facing metrics.

Create an AI-powered workflow that dramatically reduces the time required to investigate complex customer-reported data issues.

Launch a new forecasting capability or AI-powered analytical feature that expands how clients use our products.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

You have 4+ years of experience in data analytics, with a background in financial services, consulting, data science, product analytics, or another environment where complex data informs high-stakes decisions.

You have advanced SQL skills and experience using Python or PySpark to build reliable, reusable analytical workflows.

You enjoy building products—not just analyzing data—and naturally think about how information should be packaged, delivered, and experienced by customers.

You quickly develop strong mental models for complex datasets and enjoy reasoning through ambiguity to identify root causes and improve methodologies.

You have led complex cross-functional projects involving Product, Engineering, or analytical stakeholders and are comfortable driving work from idea to execution.

You know how to balance rigor with pragmatism, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term product value.

You're skilled at working with messy, evolving datasets and enjoy creating structure, repeatability, and confidence in complex systems.

You communicate technical concepts clearly and can explain methodologies, assumptions, and tradeoffs to both technical teammates and business stakeholders.

You actively use AI tools and are excited about fundamentally changing how analytical products are built—not just making existing workflows more efficient.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description_text:
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
Core areas of impact include:

Workload Development: Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.

Quality Evaluation: Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.

Knowledge Curation: Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.

Operational Support: Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.

Production Readiness: Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

Responsibilities:

Workload Development: Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.

Quality Evaluation: Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.

Knowledge Curation: Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.

Workload Operations: Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.

Integration Development: Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.

Production Readiness: Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.

Technical Documentation: Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.

Platform Contribution: Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.

Stakeholder Communication: Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.

Continuous Improvement: Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

Proven Characteristics for Success

Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.

Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.

Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.

Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.

Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.

Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.

Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.

Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.

Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.

Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.

Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.

Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.

Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.

Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.

Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

title: Data Analyst II
description_text:
About Us
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy. Our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights. The world's top investment funds and Fortune 500 companies depend on our data to drive high-stakes decisions.
We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It's Like to Work Here

Ownership is real, not aspirational. An analyst here can own a data product end-to-end—from methodology to client delivery—and directly influence products used by many of the world's largest investment firms.

Growth is driven by impact, not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. We promote based on what you've done, not how long you've been here.

AI is a core working tool. We're actively rebuilding how analytical work gets done—using AI agents, automation, and new tooling to fundamentally change what's possible. If you're excited by that, you'll thrive here.

About the Role
YipitData's Data Feeds team transforms our proprietary datasets into commercial data products used by many of the world's largest hedge funds, asset managers, and quantitative investors. Our products help investors answer questions about consumer spending, enterprise software adoption, cloud infrastructure, healthcare, and dozens of other markets—using proprietary datasets that clients integrate directly into their investment workflows.
The Data Feeds team creates products that fit seamlessly into client investment workflows—whether that's through granular datasets, aggregated metrics, forecasting methodologies, APIs, or entirely new AI-powered product experiences.
As an analyst on the team, you'll sit at the intersection of analytics, product, and commercialization. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Central Data, Data Science, Engineering, Quant Research, and Client Strategy to continuously improve how clients consume and derive value from our data.
We're hiring across multiple products, including:

Kepler — consumer transaction datasets powering institutional investment workflows through granular transaction data, aggregated metrics, and forecasting products.

Summit — B2B spend datasets built from purchase and invoice data, helping investors understand enterprise software, industrials, healthcare, and other sectors.

Edison – email receipt datasets built from one of the industry's largest anonymized inbox panels, helping investors track consumer purchases, subscriptions, travel, and digital commerce across thousands of merchants.

SpendHound – Proprietary B2B software spend datasets built from ERP, expense, and invoice data, helping investors understand software adoption, customer retention, competitive dynamics, and enterprise technology spending.

Cloud – Enterprise cloud infrastructure data covering AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud, combining proprietary spend panels with pricing and capacity data to help investors understand cloud growth, AI infrastructure demand, and competitive dynamics.

This role is different from a traditional Data Analyst position. Success isn't measured by how many analyses you complete. It's measured by the quality of the products you build, the customer problems you solve, and the leverage you create for clients and the business.
We’re open to hiring this role at multiple levels. While the position is posted as Senior Data Analyst, we encourage applications from candidates with a range of experience who can demonstrate strong analytical judgment, ownership, and growth potential. Final title, scope, and compensation will be calibrated based on experience and demonstrated skills.
As an analyst on the Data Feeds team, you will:

Own commercial data products – Own products end-to-end, from methodology development and product QA to feature design and ongoing product evolution. Develop deep expertise in how your product works and the investment workflows it supports.

Improve product quality through systems – Investigate complex data quality issues spanning upstream datasets, product methodologies, and downstream customer outputs. Build scalable monitoring, validation, and QA frameworks that improve quality while reducing manual effort.

Shape the evolution of the product – Work with Product Managers, Data Science, and Central Data. Identify opportunities for new methodologies, additional datasets, forecasting capabilities, AI-powered features, and entirely new product offerings.

Evaluate new data and methodologies – Analyze new internal and third-party datasets to determine whether they improve product accuracy, coverage, or customer value. Design experiments, quantify tradeoffs, and help determine what belongs in production.

Turn customer feedback into better products - Partner with Product Managers, Client Strategy and directly with sophisticated investors to understand how products are being used. Translate customer questions, trial feedback, and support escalations into durable product improvements.

Use AI to redesign analytical workflows – Leverage AI agents, automation, and evaluation frameworks to improve QA, documentation, methodology development, and customer-facing analytical experiences.

Build the next generation of data products – Look beyond maintaining today's products. Identify opportunities to create new analytical capabilities, improve client workflows, and expand the ways customers interact with our data.

Example Projects
Over your first year, you might:

Design a new aggregation methodology that significantly improves the accuracy of a commercial transaction product.

Evaluate a new third-party dataset and determine whether it should become part of a production product.

Build automated QA monitors that proactively detect regressions before customers notice them.

Partner with Data Science to evaluate the impact of model improvements on customer-facing metrics.

Create an AI-powered workflow that dramatically reduces the time required to investigate complex customer-reported data issues.

Launch a new forecasting capability or AI-powered analytical feature that expands how clients use our products.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

You have 4+ years of experience in data analytics, with a background in financial services, consulting, data science, product analytics, or another environment where complex data informs high-stakes decisions.

You have advanced SQL skills and experience using Python or PySpark to build reliable, reusable analytical workflows.

You enjoy building products—not just analyzing data—and naturally think about how information should be packaged, delivered, and experienced by customers.

You quickly develop strong mental models for complex datasets and enjoy reasoning through ambiguity to identify root causes and improve methodologies.

You have led complex cross-functional projects involving Product, Engineering, or analytical stakeholders and are comfortable driving work from idea to execution.

You know how to balance rigor with pragmatism, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term product value.

You're skilled at working with messy, evolving datasets and enjoy creating structure, repeatability, and confidence in complex systems.

You communicate technical concepts clearly and can explain methodologies, assumptions, and tradeoffs to both technical teammates and business stakeholders.

You actively use AI tools and are excited about fundamentally changing how analytical products are built—not just making existing workflows more efficient.

description_text:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. Who We Are
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Summary

Your Career 
As the Principal for Competitive Intelligence within the Cortex Product Management organization, you are the strategic link between the competitive landscape and our product roadmap. You don't just report on the market; you influence what we build. By applying Structured Analytic Techniques (SATs) to technical competitive data, you will provide the "Inconvenient Truths" that challenge our product assumptions. You will be responsible for ensuring that Cortex doesn't just match competitor features, but maintains a structural architectural advantage that is validated by evidence and field reality.
Your Impact

Use SATs (like Alternative Futures Analysis) to identify upcoming competitor pivots, ensuring the Cortex roadmap accounts for "next-gen" threats before they materialize in the field.

Ownership of SIEM portfolio, acting as the direct liaison and influencer to the Product Management organization. You will translate deep research results into Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), prioritize feature gaps based on competitive urgency, and present key takeaways to senior leaders.

Partner with the Enablement Lead to turn strategic product insights into "Kill" campaigns. When the competition launches a new capability, you define our immediate product-level counter-narrative.

Perform deep-dive assessments into competitor telemetry, data ingestion, and AI logic to identify where PANW has a "Technical Moat" and where we are at risk of commoditization.

Go beyond CRM data to conduct "post-mortem analysis" deep dives on significant losses, delivering actionable product feedback to Engineering and PM leadership to remove technical friction in the sales cycle.

Qualifications 

Your Experience

8+ years in CI, Product Management, or Sales Engineering within the Cybersecurity space (XDR, SIEM, or SOC automation).

Mastery of Structured Analytic Techniques. You must be able to move beyond "feature checklists" to produce high-nuance analysis that can withstand questioning from senior Product and Engineering leaders.

You can read a technical spec and understand the downstream implications for a SOC Analyst. You aren't just looking at the UI; you are looking at the architecture.

A core requirement for this team. You must be comfortable telling Product Leaders where their product is failing against the competition and backing it up with evidence.

Proven mastery in distilling high-density technical data and complex market signals into concise, high-impact "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) briefings. (You must demonstrate the ability to strip away technical noise to deliver clear, actionable recommendations that direct-influence Product and Executive decision-making.)

Experience facilitating "Red Team" sessions for product launches to identify how competitors will likely attack our new features.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience as a PM or TMM is a significant plus, as you will need to speak the language of engineering trade-offs.

Experience in ACH (Analysis of Competing Hypotheses) or other formal intelligence frameworks used to evaluate technical claims.

Deep familiarity with how security products are actually deployed and used in a 24/7 SOC environment.

CI Certification like CIP or similar.

The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.$159,000.00 - $255,000.00/yr

description_text:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family.
